sentences.text: Barracudasauroides was a reptile that swam in ancient seas.
Scientists place this animal in the family Mixosauridae, within the subfamily Mixosaurinae and the infraorder Mixosauria.
Fossils were discovered in Guizhou Province, China, from a partial skeleton specimen designated GMPKU-P-1033.
Michael W. Maisch named the genus in 2010, serving as its authority.
The type species is B. panxianensis, which was originally described as Mixosaurus by Jiang, Schmitz, Hao & Sun in 2006.
Researchers have recorded eight fossil occurrences of this animal.
This creature lived during the Middle Triassic period, specifically in the Pelsonian substage of the Anisian stage.
